title: Move own-abandonment diagnostic retirement into its owning module
outcome: Own-abandonment diagnostic retirement lives with the prune, cap and mismatch routes in engram_launch_diagnostics.rs while preserving the exact enabled, Current, runtime/turn and window semantics.
acceptance: The bounded own-abandonment diagnostic retirement loop is moved from engram_turn_checks.rs into a helper owned by engram_launch_diagnostics.rs, without behavior changes.
Existing own-abandonment, disabled-session/project, runtime/turn ownership and launch-window tests still pass.
